title: SCS-001 — Auto-deliver immediately after batch-produce (close the loop)
rationale: batch-produce.ts produces videos and writes to publish-ledger (Sprint 1316) but never delivers them to Telegram. The operator waits up to 9 hours for the next auto-deliver cron (07:30/12:00/18:00). Fix: add execSync posting-auto-deliver.ts --batch N call at end of batch-produce main(), so videos reach Telegram within seconds of production.

tasks.description: In scripts/scs001/batch-produce.ts, after saving the report, add execSync call to run posting-auto-deliver.ts --batch N (where N = results.length). Wrap in try/catch so delivery failure doesn't fail the batch. Skip if no results or dryRun. Use 120000ms timeout.
